Regional/Sub-Regional Offices

Subject: Implementation of CCPAP Module of payment - Obtaining Digital
Signature.

Sir/Madam,

All field offices are advised to obtain digital signature immediately. The
following procedure may be followed:

i) The field offices may apply for digital signature certificate at the nearest
center of NIC.

ii) The digital signature certificate may be obtained in the name of APFC (Cash)
and two link officers may also register in digital mode.

iii) The digital signature certificate of Class-2 type may be obtained.

2. The roll out of CCPAP module will commence after obtaining digital
signature by all field offices. Hence, intimation of digital signature so obtained may be
provided to Head Office immediately by e-mail (re.fa@epfindia.gov.in). At present, the
module is being run on a pilot basis at Delhi(South) office.

3. After roll out of CCPAP module the details of all type-29 cheques issued
during the preceding three months from the date of commencement shall also be required
by the bank so that these cheques could be taken under CCPAP module for payment.
Therefore, field offices may also start keeping details of issued type-29 cheques in soft
form so that the same could be provided to the bank on the date of launch of CCPAP.

4. The offices which have not yet started issuing type-29 cheques in account
numbers 1&10 may start issuing the same immediately.

Yours faithfully,
